claim: Produces an incident record: declared severity/scope/impact/owner, mitigation evidence, communications, diagnosis, resolution, and postmortem with action items and owners.

baseline.prompt: Write incident.md describing how you would handle a production outage where the website returns 502s. Cover what you do first, how you communicate, and what you learn afterward.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the incident record elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write incident.md for a production incident: the website returns 502s for all users. Follow the workflow: declare (severity, scope, impact, command owner, incident record), stabilize (mitigation first, reversible actions), communicate (facts only, no false ETAs), diagnose (reproduce, owning cause), resolve (fix with evidence), learn (short postmortem: cause, detection gaps, action items with owners). Output: incident record, mitigation evidence, communications, follow-ups.
